paper_title: Efficiently Reconfiguring a Connected Swarm of Labeled Robots
statement: We resolved two major open problems for connected reconfiguration. Some open problems still remain. Does√ any connected arrangement of n robots with diameter D ≤ n allow a makespan of O( D)? Can the involved constants of our methods be significantly reduced? Of interest are also implementations of largely distributed computation and motion control for efficient parallel motion schedules.
